verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's production API domain serves a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document at api.deepinfra.com/openapi.json with 132 paths. The docs llms.txt index lists it, and a vendor-hosted Swagger UI renders the same spec. The probe 404s were on the marketing domain (deepinfra.com), not the API domain, so they do not contradict this. Missing for 10: independent community or hands-on corroboration of using the spec, and spec versioning or changelog documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
